Location: Niigata Prefecture, Japan
Description:

A Machine Maintenance position is available for onshore drilling operations in Niigata Prefecture, Japan. The role involves cleaning, painting, and assembling equipment, as well as performing manual dismantling and maintenance. Candidates require at least 10 years of experience in the oil, natural gas, or well drilling industry, with hands-on experience in equipment maintenance. Business-level English is required; Japanese is not necessary. Salary offered is JPY 350,000–380,000 per month.
